build_text_dataset_from_files: build a huggingface dataset from plain text files using the Text builder with line sampling
configure_textconfig_encoding: configure a TextConfig with custom encoding and chunksize for loading text files
generate_tables_by_paragraph: generate PyArrow tables from text files by splitting on paragraph boundaries
cast_arrow_table_to_schema: cast a PyArrow table to a custom features schema using _cast_table
load_text_as_single_document: load an entire text file as a single document using sample_by document mode
